description: This file is a Jinja2 template used for rendering a sales invoice return print format in ERPNext. It contains macro definitions for rendering currency, taxes, and tables, as well as layout code for generating the invoice pages with headers, footers, and various sections.

methods.name: render_currency
methods.description: Macro to render currency fields with proper formatting and styling.

methods.name: render_taxes
methods.description: Macro to render taxes associated with the document, including conditional display logic.

methods.name: render_table
methods.description: Macro to render a table of line items with support for nested templates and visibility controls.
